conceptPrompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity desktop website concept screenshot, 1536x1024 landscape, for an original Japanese vertical horror webcomic titled 「天井のむこう」. Opening screen only of a complete experience whose downstream sections are vertical illustrated story, attic flashlight discovery, nine-frame automatic scrolling ghost attack, black ending. Design direction: cinematic Japanese ink horror, charcoal-black #080909 background, weathered grey textured timber, dusty muted beige flashlight, delicate off-white Japanese Mincho typography, restrained tiny red accent. Absolutely no bright gradients, cards, badges or generic marketing elements. The screen has a tiny header 'UNFILED' at top left with subtle left arrow, '音 OFF' at top right. Main layout asymmetric: the left third contains large Japanese serif title on two lines 天井の / むこう, then small quiet line '両親がいなくなった家で、まだ音がする。', then a thin outlined rectangle CTA '読みはじめる' with small downward arrow, below a small unobtrusive label '音と動きのある短編漫画'. Right two thirds is a richly rendered original manga illustration, a dark empty Japanese tatami room with stacked moving boxes and an open oshiire closet, displaced small wooden hatch leading into black attic, very slight warm flashlight beam disappearing into rafters. No ghost visible in the opening. Large negative space, thoughtful typesetting, serious graphic novel publishing aesthetic. Edge blend art into black page without color wash. Native UI text and controls will be HTML. No browser chrome, no device mockup. Footer small centered '下へ、ゆっくり。'. Assets must be practically separable, page works on mobile by stacking title above art.
